from pathlib import Path

CONFIG_PATH = Path("/etc/myapp/defaults.json")
_CONFIG_CACHE = {}

def load_config(path):
    key = str(path.resolve())
    cached = _CONFIG_CACHE.get(key)
    if cached is not None:
        return cached
    text = path.read_text()
    _CONFIG_CACHE[key] = text
    return text

def build_response(user_id):
    config = load_config(CONFIG_PATH)
    return format_response(user_id, config)

def run_batch(user_ids):
    out = []
    for user_id in user_ids:
        out.append(build_response(user_id))
    return out
